summary: Vitalik 转告 eth.limo 的 DNS 注册商遭到攻击，提醒大家在确认恢复前不要访问相关 .eth.limo 页面，可直接通过 IPFS 访问他的博客。derekchiang 提交 EIP-8141 修改，把交易类型混入签名哈希。ACDC #178 议程发布，会议定于 5 月 14 日。

items.title: Vitalik：eth.limo 告知其 DNS 注册商遭到攻击，确认恢复正常之前请不要访问 vitalik.eth.limo 或其他 .eth.limo 页面，可通过 IPFS 直接查看博客
items.title_en: Vitalik: eth.limo warned him of an attack on their DNS registrar, so do not visit vitalik.eth.limo or other .eth.limo pages until they confirm things are back to normal; the blog can be read via IPFS directly

summary_en: Vitalik relayed that eth.limo's DNS registrar had been attacked and asked people not to visit the affected .eth.limo pages until it was confirmed safe, pointing to his blog on IPFS. derekchiang submitted an EIP-8141 change mixing the transaction type into the signature hash. The ACDC #178 agenda was posted for May 14.
